metadata.case_name: LEUNG WING KAI AND ANOTHER v. SHUN DIK INDUSTRIAL CO

plaintiff.occupation_before: apprenticed to the defendant, operating a plastic moulding machine
plaintiff.education_level: left school after reaching F3 level

injuries.description: his right middle, index and ring fingers were amputated to proximal phaloux level.
injuries.body_part: right middle, index and ring fingers
source: his right middle, index and ring fingers were amputated to proximal phaloux level.
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic amputation of two or more fingers at or near base, right hand

manifestations.description: his right hand was caught by the machine and his fingers crushed.
He has a permanent loss of grip.

treatments_received: follow up outpatient visits until 23 January 1979 (about 40 visits)

losses.description: Permanent loss of grip and amputation of right middle, index and ring fingers.
He decided that his future no longer lay in manual labour, so he went back to school.
